df = read_df("final_grades_math201_s03.csv")
print("Columns:", list(df.columns), "| Rows:", len(df))

# Locate the three components (report if any are missing rather than assume)
#   assignments (~40%), midterm (~30%), final (~30%)
# and the existing grade column for comparison.

df["computed_course_grade"] = (
    0.40 * df["assignments"] +
    0.30 * df["midterm"] +
    0.30 * df["final_exam"]
)

# Rows where computed differs from the stored grade by more than 0.5
diff = (df["computed_course_grade"] - df["existing_grade"]).abs()
discrepant = df.loc[diff > 0.5, ["student_id", "assignments", "midterm",
                                 "final_exam", "existing_grade", "computed_course_grade"]]
print(f"{len(discrepant)} students differ by > 0.5 points")
print(discrepant)
